run_pipeline_generate_text: run the AWS Bedrock Claude pipeline to generate text responses via the pipe method
run_pipeline_stream_response: run the pipeline with streaming enabled to receive chunked Claude responses via stream_response
build_pipeline_get_models: build a list of available Anthropic Claude models from AWS Bedrock using get_models
build_pipeline_update_pipelines: build and initialize the Bedrock client and pipeline model list via update_pipelines
test_pipeline_process_image: test processing base64-encoded or URL images for Claude vision input via process_image
